messages.subject: CJS Constant Parameter Model
parts:
Hi All,
I am fairly new to Hierarchical modeling for population analysis, and I have been struggling with running a CJS model. I have a encounter history with 82 individuals and capture data was collected over three years. When adapting the CJS Constant Parameter model code provided for JAGS from Kery and Schaub(2012), I get the error when calling JAGS from R:

"Error in jags.model(file = model.file, data = data, inits = inits, n.chains = n.chains, : RUNTIME ERROR: Compilation error on line 8. Unknown variable nInd Either supply values for this variable with the data or define it on the left hand side of a relation. In addition: Warning messages: 1: In jags.model(file = model.file, data = data, inits = inits, n.chains = n.chains, : Unused variable "f" in data 2: In jags.model(file = model.file, data = data, inits = inits, n.chains = n.chains, : Unused variable "nind" in data 3: In jags.model(file = model.file, data = data, inits = inits, n.chains = n.chains, : Unused variable "n.occasions" in data"

Can anyone help me please? I can provide more code if needed.

Thank you in advance!

John
